title: I Tried Day Trading for 1 Week (Complete Beginner)
summary: Beginner follows Discord options signals for a week with a small account, goes nearly all-in on single trades, sells winners early, ends down; brokerage sponsor segment.

assertions.quote: When the price of a stock moves a little bit, the price of that option moves a lot.

verdicts.note: Options have leverage built into their price via delta and gamma.

assertions.quote: So if we look at the whole account for the entire week, I ended up losing about -$450.

verdicts.note: First-hand tests and brokerage data lean to losses, but signal quality varies and samples are small.

assertions.quote: this is the number one way to blow your entire account
almost every trade I made this week, I ended up selling at the bottom

verdicts.note: Retail day traders are reluctant to close losing day trades (disposition effect) and including those days makes measured performance worse, but the study does not show this is the main cause of losses.

assertions.quote: I also see the degenerates on Wall Street Bets lose their entire house doing this
